title: 第23章 焚血祭灵第24章 准了
content_zh:
杨灵睿也是拍着手说：“还得是清姐，分析得如此透彻。”
杨贯峰和余老看着杨灵清说的头头是道，不禁露出赞赏的目光，频频点头。
能出个杨灵清这样头脑灵活有性子沉稳的后辈，是多少家族做梦都求不来的。
“灵清说得不错，怪不得只有你才能与那灵石沟通。”
经历兽潮一战后，如今杨家对陈阳已是改了称呼。
对外如果有人问起，他们还会讲是一块异石，但在私下，已经将他唤为灵石。
众人的目光再度落向禁地祠堂。
杨贯峰带着其余四人走进，陈阳此刻正静静的被摆放在最中间的位置上。
五人站定，杨贯峰便恭敬的向陈阳拱手道：“此次兽潮，多谢灵石前辈护我杨家周全，救命之恩，杨家感激不尽！”
随后他带着其余四人拜向陈阳。
他这话说的言辞恳切、情感真挚，毫无作假。
事实也确实如此，若是没有陈阳，都等不到狐妖现身，就那只聚气四重的猿猴妖兽，便能叫杨家三百多口人尽数覆灭。
当确认陈阳可能拥有神智后，杨贯峰与余老也是从头到尾开始了细细复盘。
地宝小秘境初见，他们发现了四叶衔灵草，临走因为余老察觉了一丝灵气波动，这才注意到了角落里的陈阳。
之后将其带回家中，王烈以磁石破坏阵法，他再度放出波动，将杨灵清唤醒，没有让王烈的偷袭得手。
再往后，便是兽潮开始后，他不断的提醒灵清和灵虎二人妖兽的到来，还在最危急的时刻，一击将那狐妖秒杀，拯救了两个孩子的性命。
如今看来，这发生的一切绝非巧合。
甚至，从一开始，这灵石可能就已有了神智！
换言之，不是他们将灵石从秘境中带了出来，而是这灵石选择了他们杨家！
余老还因此脑补了更多桥段，还得出结论，认为就连他们进入秘境后的路线，也可能是有着灵石的引导！

确认此事后，杨家众人也是不敢怠慢，赶忙将陈阳从院中高台换到了祠堂之中，排在了与列祖列宗相同的地位。
其他四人也尝试与陈阳进行沟通，可是很可惜，目前只有杨灵清与他讲话，才偶尔会有反应，其他人与其交流都是宛如一块死物。
众人分析后觉得，应该是灵清这孩子经常与灵石沟通，得到了灵石认可的缘故。
现在的祠堂内，杨家众修士便决定以一种特殊手段，来报答陈阳对整个杨家的救命之恩。
只见杨贯峰话音落下，便从袖中取出一张火符置于掌心。
心念微动间，火符熊熊燃起。
随后他伸出另一只手，凝聚灵力冲破指尖。
一滴带着灵光的血珠从中飞出。
身后的余老和三个孩子也照他所做，取出了一滴血液。
这不是普通的血液，这是修士凝聚气府后，丹田中独有的精血，相当珍贵。
每失去一滴，都要花费大量的时间来重新凝练。
精血不足会导致修士无法使用术法，精血亏空更是会使得修士修为倒退。
就是这样对修士而言宛如身家性命般的东西，如今杨家五名修士一人取出一滴。
众人催动灵力，将指尖精血引向杨贯峰掌心那团火焰。
精血与火相触的瞬间，爆发出极为耀眼的橙色光芒，整座禁地都被照亮。
若非有着阵法隔绝，叫山下凡人见了，都得以为是出现了第二个太阳。
五滴精血在光芒中融合蒸腾，随着它们化作一缕鲜红灵气后，光芒也随之消散。
接着，这缕奇异的灵气慢慢飘向陈阳。
“嗯？这气息...好香啊！”
content_en:
Yang Lingrui also clapped her hands and said, "It must be Sister Qing who analyzes it so thoroughly."
Yang Guanfeng and Mr. Yu looked at Yang Lingqing's eloquent words and couldn't help showing admiration and nodding frequently.
To have a young man with a flexible mind and a calm temperament like Yang Lingqing is something that many families can only dream of.
"Lingqing is right. No wonder only you can communicate with the spirit stone."
After experiencing the beast tide, the Yang family has now changed their name to Chen Yang.
If anyone asks externally, they will still say it is a strange stone, but privately, they have already called him a spiritual stone.
Everyone's eyes fell on the forbidden ancestral hall again.
Yang Guanfeng walked in with the other four people, and Chen Yang was quietly placed in the middle position.
The five of them stood still, and Yang Guanfeng bowed his hands to Chen Yang respectfully and said, "Thank you to Senior Lingshi for protecting my Yang family during this wave of beasts. The Yang family is deeply grateful for your life-saving grace!"
Then he took the other four people to pay homage to Chen Yang.
What he said was sincere, his emotions were sincere, and there was no deception.
This is indeed the case. If it weren't for Chen Yang, the ape monster with the fourth level of energy gathering would have wiped out more than 300 members of the Yang family before the fox demon showed up.
After confirming that Chen Yang might have sanity, Yang Guanfeng and Yu Lao also began to review the story in detail from beginning to end.
When they first met in the Dibao Little Secret Realm, they discovered the four-leaf spiritual grass. Before leaving, Mr. Yu noticed a trace of spiritual energy fluctuations, and then he noticed Chen Yang in the corner.
After taking him home, Wang Lie used magnets to destroy the formation. He released waves again, awakening Yang Lingqing and preventing Wang Lie's sneak attack from succeeding.
Later, when the beast tide started, he kept reminding Lingqing and Linghu of the arrival of the beast, and at the most critical moment, he killed the fox demon instantly with one blow, saving the lives of the two children.
Now it seems that what happened is no coincidence.
In fact, this spiritual stone may have been sane from the beginning!
In other words, they did not bring the spirit stone out of the secret realm, but the spirit stone chose their Yang family!
Mr. Yu also imagined more plots because of this, and came to the conclusion that even their route after entering the secret realm might be guided by spiritual stones!
After confirming the matter, everyone in the Yang family did not dare to neglect and hurriedly moved Chen Yang from the high platform in the courtyard to the ancestral hall, ranking him in the same position as his ancestors.
The other four people also tried to communicate with Chen Yang, but unfortunately, only Yang Lingqing occasionally reacted when talking to him, and the others were like a dead object when communicating with him.
After analysis, everyone felt that it should be because the child Lingqing often communicated with Lingshi and was recognized by Lingshi.
In the current ancestral hall, the monks of the Yang family decided to use a special method to repay Chen Yang for saving the entire Yang family.
After Yang Guanfeng finished speaking, he took out a fire charm from his sleeve and placed it in his palm.
With a slight movement of thought, the fire talisman ignited.
Then he stretched out his other hand and concentrated his spiritual power to break through his fingertips.
A drop of blood with spiritual light flew out from it.
Mr. Yu and the three children behind him also did what he did and took out a drop of blood.
This is not ordinary blood, this is the unique blood essence in the Dantian after the monks have condensed their Qi. It is quite precious.
Every drop lost takes a lot of time to re-concentrate.
Insufficient essence and blood will cause the monk to be unable to use spells, and depletion of essence and blood will cause the monk's cultivation to regress.
This is something that is like wealth and life to the monks. Now each of the five monks of the Yang family took out a drop.
Everyone mobilized their spiritual power and directed the essence and blood from their fingertips to the flame in Yang Guanfeng's palm.
The moment the essence and blood touched the fire, an extremely dazzling orange light erupted, and the entire forbidden area was illuminated.
If it weren't for the isolation of the formation, mortals at the foot of the mountain would have thought that a second sun had appeared.
Five drops of essence and blood merged and steamed in the light, and as they turned into a wisp of bright red spiritAfter the Qi, the light also dissipated.
Then, this strange spiritual energy slowly floated towards Chen Yang.
"Huh? This smell... smells so good!"
